definitions.Z_normwise_criterion: r_m=max(abs(Z_residual[m,0:65])); require r_m <= 1e-12*C_m with finite scale, residual and eta and C_m>=0
definitions.Z_normwise_eta: r_m/C_m when C_m>0; exactly 0 when C_m=0 and all residual bins are exactly 0; otherwise infinity and failure, never an epsilon substitution
definitions.Z_residual_and_scale: Z_ref - Z_sum, and original-pulse-order sum(abs(Z_i)); full complex residual and real scale saved
definitions.Z_time_L1_scale: C_m: original-pulse-order binary64 scalar sum of np.sum(np.abs(weighted_input), dtype=np.float64); weighted_input is the identical rounded observer_input*h buffer passed to each FFT
definitions.auxiliary_values: Center-band values outside search_membership_by_band are auxiliary only and cannot be interpreted as fixed-event measurements
definitions.delta_definition: SHAPE-PML, FULL-SHAPE, FULL-PML; delta_P_ref=delta_self_sum+delta_cross_sum+delta_power_residual, with floating balance residual retained
definitions.failure_locations: Boolean gate arrays retain every coordinate; false saved_power_valid values are failures only within search_membership_by_band
definitions.gram: G_ij = sum_k(a_k * Z_i * conjugate(Z_j)) / D over the fixed band
definitions.kernel_alignment: Native post-taper samples copied into float64 input [center-40,center+40) at their absolute sample positions
definitions.legacy_Z_valid: All old per-bin booleans, scales and residuals retained unchanged; false counts and coordinates reported with required=false
definitions.new_scale_limitation: Post-failure observation-contract revision, not an FFT theoretical error bound, interval proof, or weak-bin relative-accuracy guarantee; the coefficient remains 1e-12
definitions.no_S_final_algebra_gate: The captured complex64 S arrays are retained separately; no 1e-12 test of S_FULL=c**M*S_SHAPE is imposed
definitions.observer: h is the SHA-fixed float64[80] saved by prior condition-01, never regenerated; FFT length 128, Fs 16000, all 65 bins; internal weights 2 and DC/Nyquist 1; D=128*sum(h**2)
definitions.pair_allocation: No signed cross term allocated to either cell; no output-power percentage or signed-term dB conversion
definitions.region_abs_cross_sum: Sum of absolute region-mean pair terms; center_mean_abs_cross_sum separately preserves mean center-wise absolute pair sum
definitions.region_gram: Unweighted arithmetic mean of each center Gram in the fixed region; no cell rows removed
definitions.saved_power_comparison: P_ref-P_saved; scale=abs(P_ref)+abs(P_saved); evaluated only at that band's saved search membership
definitions.self_and_cross: d_i=real(G_ii); q_ij=2*real(G_ij) only for original pulse-order i<j; all pairs including exact zeros retained
definitions.sparse_order: Cell-major, then saved-center order; cells are in original pulse order
definitions.sparse_reconstruction: Initialize dense (N, m, 65) complex128 zeros; assign Z_sparse at sparse_cell_center_index[:,0], sparse_cell_center_index[:,1]
definitions.sparse_rule: Keep every pair with a_i < center+40 and b_i > center-40 and a_i < b_i; all other Z are exact geometric zero
